reader.notes: BeginGroup returns false before any line, fit test, page advance or NEXT GROUP when the group has no present line or its hook ran SUPPRESS, on every presentation path (body, PH, PF, RH/RF). Probed at 85 for nonprintable RH, CH, CF FINAL and suppressed CF, PH, PF.

refuter.evidence: Aimed at what the reader did not try: SUPPRESS of groups that carry NEXT GROUP, and nonprintable PH/PF/RF/DE. r4sup-001 (PAGE 12 HD 1 FD 3 LD 8 FT 10): suppressed RH with NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE -> no page advance, PH 02 on page 1 (LC=05 PC=01 after the first DE); suppressed DE with NEXT GROUP PLUS 2 -> LC stays 05; suppressed CH (NEXT GROUP PLUS 3) and suppressed CF with NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE at a break -> next DE on the same page at line 6 (LC=08 PC=01); suppressed DE whose fit test would fail (8+1>LD 8) -> no page advance (LC=08 PC=01); suppressed RF at TERMINATE -> LC=08 PC=01. r4np-001: nonprintable PH (LC=00 before, DE at FD 3), nonprintable DE (LC stays 03), nonprintable PF on the page advance (PH sees LC=00 PC=02), nonprintable PF and RF at TERMINATE (LC stays 03). All match XIII-74 SUPPRESS GR3 b-d and the tables' 'unaffected by the processing of a nonprintable report group' rows. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.3.5.6 GR5; OK §1985:XIII.4.6.4 GR3. Side note, not this rule: PERFORM of a nondeclarative paragraph from a USE BEFORE REPORTING section is only a warning (COBOL2375).
